meta.purpose: Implement Task Group E (“Quality gates”) from the X-to-Demo AI-first pipeline task list. These changes MUST NOT add a new pipeline phase (keep Option A: feature_spec → demo_spec → code_spec).

inputs.task_list_markdown_ref: Task Group E — Quality gates (optional, still Option A)

global_principles.ai_first: AI/technical innovation is the first-class citizen. Demo scope is limited to 1–3 headline items.
global_principles.minimalism: Minimalist UI; avoid “plumbing” unless explicitly required. Browser-compatible always; smartphone-framed view only if the proposal indicates a mobile app.
global_principles.openai_integration: CodeSpec MUST select at least one of: Responses API, Realtime API, Agents SDK. Tools only if absolutely necessary; if used, must use synthetic data and display tool calls/results in UI.
global_principles.walkthrough: Interactive in-app walkthrough (auto-start, retriggerable, cancellable). Not a presenter script.
global_principles.testing: CodeSpec must mandate comprehensive unit tests and running them continuously during build.

in_scope.item: Add schema fields and prompt instructions to enforce Task Group E quality gates.
Keep pipeline phases unchanged; only adjust schema models and prompt templates as needed.
Ensure strict structured-output JSON Schema compatibility (additionalProperties false, required fields, etc.).

out_of_scope.item: Adding new pipeline phases or complex orchestration changes.
XToDemoStudio UI/auth or any app/web UI not directly part of spec generation.
Non-essential infrastructure (auth, billing, observability, CI/CD, etc.) unless explicitly demanded by proposal.

task.name: Synthetic-first demo input data
task.goal: Every generated DemoSpec must include synthetic input data so the downstream demo can run deterministically on first launch, enabling immediate testing/validation without ad-hoc human input.

structure.field: Small, human-readable dataset embedded as JSON/text. Must be safe and non-PII.
Exact inputs the demo app should use on first launch to exercise the headline capabilities.
Explain how the synthetic data covers the 1–3 headline capabilities.
Confirm no unsafe content/PII; realistic but bounded.
What the demo should display for the first run (can be structured expectations or concise textual expectations).

schema_rules.rule: Field MUST be required in DemoSpec schema.
Keep payload small; embed minimal datasets only.
Must align to headline demo items (1–3).

structure.field: Where synthetic data lives in repo (e.g., local JSON file path or module constant).
How app loads synthetic data deterministically on startup.
How the first-run flow auto-populates inputs and triggers the initial run.
How user can reset to the seed and re-run identical demo.
Use deterministic parameters where possible; otherwise define expected structure/snapshots.

schema_rules.rule: Field MUST be required in CodeSpec schema.
Must be implementation-ready but stack-flexible (describe behavior, not frameworks).

instructions.instruction: Demo must succeed on FIRST LAUNCH using synthetic inputs; include seed dataset, first-run inputs, and expected outputs.
Synthetic data must be explicitly designed to exercise the 1–3 headline capabilities and avoid undefined behavior.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: DemoSpec output always contains complete synthetic_demo_inputs (seed, default inputs, expected outputs).
CodeSpec output always contains a clear plan to store/load/apply synthetic data on first run and allow deterministic reruns.

task.name: Internal consistency requirements
task.goal: Enforce cross-phase consistency: Phase 2 demo items must reference Phase 1 headline capabilities; Phase 3 must reflect the same headline items and walkthrough requirements.

schema_level_where_possible.item: In DemoSpec: ensure each headline_demo_item references a capability_ref that matches Phase 1 naming/IDs. (Schema can enforce “presence and shape”; prompts enforce correct referencing.)
In CodeSpec: ensure structures (prompt_pack, walkthrough_implementation, tests) are explicitly enumerated per headline item.

prompt_level_validation_expectations.item: Add explicit “consistency checklist” reminders in each phase prompt: Phase 2 must map from Phase 1 headlines; Phase 3 must map from Phase 2 headlines and walkthrough steps.
Require the model to reuse stable identifiers/strings for headline items across phases.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: DemoSpec headline_demo_items clearly map to the Phase 1 ai_headline_capabilities via capability_ref.
CodeSpec explicitly implements and tests each headline capability and matches the walkthrough spec from DemoSpec.

task.name: Tooling-only-if-needed decision trace
task.goal: Force a justification trail for tool usage across phases: Phase 1 decides and explains; Phase 2/3 carry that forward consistently.

implementation.phase1_dependency_note: Phase 1 already has (or will have) tooling_need_assessment. Task E2 ensures the trace is preserved through Phase 2/3.

phase2_demo_spec_changes.item: Add/require a section that explicitly states whether tools are used, and if used: synthetic data + UI-visible tool call log requirement remains consistent with earlier rules.

phase3_code_spec_changes.item: Require a “tooling plan” section that either: (a) defines tool interfaces + synthetic data + UI visibility + mocks, OR (b) explicitly states “no tools used” and ensures mocks cover OpenAI calls only.

prompt_updates.item: Add an instruction: “You must keep tooling decision consistent across phases; if Phase 1 says no tools, do not introduce tools later.”
If tools are used, require a short justification and show how tool results are displayed in the demo UI.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Tooling decision is explicit in Phase 1 and carried forward without contradiction in Phase 2/3.
If tools are used, synthetic data + UI tool-call visibility + test mocks are specified.

structured_outputs.rule: All outputs must match schema exactly; no extra fields; additionalProperties:false throughout.
Prefer small, explicit objects over freeform prose where downstream agents need determinism.

stack_flexibility.rule: Describe behaviors/requirements, not specific frameworks, unless unavoidable.

deliverables.deliverable: Updated DemoSpec schema includes required synthetic_demo_inputs and consistency/tooling trace fields.
Updated CodeSpec schema includes required synthetic_data_implementation and consistent tooling plan representation.
Updated prompts enforce synthetic-first first launch, cross-phase consistency, and tooling decision trace.

done_definition.item: E0: Demo is runnable deterministically on first launch using included synthetic inputs and expected outputs.
E1: Headline items remain consistent and traceable across all 3 phases.
E2: Tooling usage is consistently justified and propagated across phases; no surprise tools later.
No new pipeline phases added; schemas remain strict and OpenAI structured-output compatible.
